pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0125 VFX first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR 0125 first-release VFX lifecycle, Project Rust control, and responsive VFX Builder background compilation/I/O on current main. Removes an obsolete preview helper exposed by affected Clippy after the background compilation migration.

## Validation

Run affected Windows validation and the deterministic VFX Builder visual fixture. Visually verify VFX Builder emitter/module authoring, curve/gradient UI, preview controls, rendered preview, and Scene View integration.
